After the bid phase there will be an on-site comparative presentation of the offered devices, followed by 15-minute negotiation talks with each bidder on the same day.
tenders.what_they_want: 12 ventilators (breathing devices) for intensive care, supporting safe invasive and non-invasive ventilation. They must be permanently installed on the existing ceiling supply units from Modultechnik (2400 and 2500 series) and weigh less than 30 kg. They must fit the existing spatial and technical conditions, dimensions and connection parameters, and be fully integrated into the existing IT and documentation infrastructure. No specific brands or model numbers are named, as the tender is manufacturer-neutral.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: NOT FOUND (the notice contains no certification, experience or company-size requirements). Only technical compliance is stated: compatibility with the Modultechnik ceiling supply units, weight under 30 kg, and IT integration. Bidders must also be able to present their devices on-site at the hospital.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: No weightings are stated. The aim is to identify the most economical, technically most suitable solution that is also optimal in operability and user-friendliness. Evaluation will include an on-site presentation round, where all bidders show their devices side by side, followed by 15-minute individual negotiation talks with each bidder to clarify open points. The schedule will be announced during the bid phase.

tenders.buyer_name: Szpital Specjalistyczny Chorób Płuc " Odrodzenie" im. Klary Jelskiej w Zakopanem
tenders.english_summary: The Specialist Lung Disease Hospital "Odrodzenie" in Zakopane, Poland, is tendering for the ongoing (staged) supply of single-use medical equipment. The tender is split into packages, with Package 1 having 4 items and Package 2 having 9 items. The detailed items are listed in Annex 1 (price calculation form) to the tender specification (SWZ), which is not included in this notice text.
tenders.what_they_want: Successive deliveries of single-use (disposable) medical equipment and consumables. Package 1 has 4 line items and Package 2 has 9 line items. Specific product types, models and brands are NOT FOUND in the text, as they are in Annex 1. Products must be CE-marked and show the notified body number where a notified body was involved in conformity assessment. They must comply with the Polish Medical Devices Act of 7 April 2022. They must be delivered in the manufacturer's original packaging. Outer and inner packaging must show the product name, batch number, production date and expiry date where applicable. Remaining shelf life must be at least 1 year from the delivery date.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: The notice text gives no company size, experience or financial criteria. Bidders must submit product evidence with the offer. This is (1) a declaration that the bidder holds the full set of documents authorising the products for placing on the market and use in the EU, including Poland, and will provide certified copies on request. It also includes (2) catalogues or brochures, with only the relevant pages and the offered product clearly marked, whose authenticity the bidder must certify on request. If these are missing or incomplete, the buyer will call for them to be submitted or completed within a set deadline under Art. 107(2) of the Polish Public Procurement Law (pzp). This does not apply where the bid is rejected anyway or there are grounds to annul the procedure. Other conditions for participation (for example the grounds for exclusion) are NOT FOUND in the text provided.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND (the text provided is truncated and does not state the award criteria or their weightings).

tenders.english_summary: University Hospital in Krakow (Szpital Uniwersytecki w Krakowie) is purchasing equipment and apparatus for anaesthesiology and intensive care units with the highest organ donation activity in 2025. The purchase covers delivery, installation, commissioning and staff training, and is divided into four items (lots): a mobile extracorporeal lung/circulatory support device, a mobile EEG machine, video laryngoscopes with accessories, and patient temperature management sets.
tenders.what_they_want: (1) Mobile device for extracorporeal circulatory/lung support (1 unit); (2) Mobile electroencephalography (EEG) apparatus (1 unit); (3) Video laryngoscope with accessories (2 units); (4) Set for controlled patient temperature management (2 units). All include delivery, installation, commissioning and training. No brands or model numbers are mentioned; detailed specifications are in the tender specification (SWZ) and its annexes.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: NOT FOUND (the notice refers to the SWZ and annexes for details, but these are not included in the description)
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND (not stated in the notice description; presumably set out in the SWZ)

tenders.original_title: DPS 4 - Supply of community equipment for small moving & handling equipment
tenders.english_summary: Croydon Council, as lead authority for the Integrated Procurement Hub (IPH), is establishing DPS 4, a Dynamic Purchasing System for supplying small moving and handling community equipment. The goods are bought on behalf of Croydon and its partner local authorities, including equipment needed for health functions delegated by NHS bodies. The DPS runs under Regulation 34 of the Public Contracts Regulations 2015, starts on 28 October 2016 for seven years, and can be extended by three years.
tenders.what_they_want: Community equipment in 32 categories of small moving and handling equipment (DPS 4). No specific model numbers or brands are mentioned. The wider DPS structure also covers DPS 1 (31 categories of complex equipment, already open), DPS 2 (28 categories of paediatric equipment, already open) and DPS 3 (102 categories of simple aids, opening).
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Suppliers must meet the DPS admission criteria in the Pre-Qualification Questionnaire (PQQ) to become an "Admitted Supplier" and be registered for one or more product categories. Suppliers and products can be submitted at any time during the DPS validity period. Unsuccessful suppliers may resubmit a revised PQQ at any time. Specific certifications, experience levels and company size requirements are NOT FOUND in this notice. They may be in the PQQ documents on www.croydoncedps.com.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND. The notice says only that suppliers and products are evaluated against the PQQ admission criteria. No price or quality weightings are given.

tenders.original_title: DPS 3 - Supply of community equipment for Simple Aids
tenders.english_summary: Croydon Council, acting as lead authority for the Integrated Procurement Hub (IPH), is establishing DPS 3, a Dynamic Purchasing System for supplying community equipment (simple aids) on behalf of itself and partner local authorities. The equipment supports health functions delegated by NHS bodies under integrated commissioning. The DPS runs under Regulation 34 of the Public Contracts Regulations 2015, opened on 28 October 2016 for seven years with a possible three-year extension, and suppliers may apply to join at any time.
tenders.what_they_want: Community equipment classed as "Simple Aids", covering 102 product categories, supplied to the IPH partner local authorities. The notice does not give specific product types, brands or model numbers. DPS 1 (complex equipment, 31 categories) and DPS 2 (paediatric equipment, 28 categories) are already open and are separate from this tender.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Suppliers must meet the DPS admission criteria in the Pre-Qualification Questionnaire (PQQ) and be registered as an "Admitted Supplier" for one or more product categories. Suppliers and products can be submitted at any time during the DPS validity period. Unsuccessful applicants may re-submit a revised PQQ at any time. The specific certifications, experience and company size requirements are NOT FOUND in this notice and are in the PQQ documents on www.croydoncedps.com.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND. The notice says only that suppliers and products are evaluated against the PQQ admission criteria. No price or quality weightings are given.

tenders.original_title: Fully Managed Renal Dialysis Satellite Unit in Crawley Area
tenders.buyer_name: Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust
tenders.english_summary: South West London Procurement Partnership, acting for Epsom and St Helier University Hospitals NHS Trust (ESTH), is seeking a single provider to run a fully managed renal dialysis satellite unit in the Crawley area. The provider must supply all facilities, equipment, consumables and renal nursing services. ESTH is procuring independently for its own Crawley-area patients and no longer jointly with University Hospitals Sussex NHS Foundation Trust, which currently shares the unit.
tenders.what_they_want: A fully managed renal (haemodialysis) satellite unit in the Crawley area. This covers the facilities, the equipment, the consumables and the renal nursing services needed to deliver the unit. Activity numbers cover only ESTH patients, with current and estimated figures in the Tender Documentation. No specific brands or model numbers are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Only general wording is given: "experienced and qualified organizations". No specific certifications, experience levels or company size requirements are stated in this notice. Further details may be in the Tender Pack.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND in the notice. It only says the aim is to select a single provider offering "high-quality, cost-effective solutions" in line with the specification in the Tender Pack. There is no price or quality weighting.

tenders.english_summary: Shropshire Council is seeking a provider to deliver an integrated 0-19 (up to 25 where appropriate) Healthy Child Programme across Shropshire. The programme covers Health Visiting, School Nursing and Family Nurse Partnership services. It is a community-based, preventative, neighbourhood-focused model that promotes health and wellbeing and reduces inequalities. The procurement runs under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023 using the Competitive Process.
tenders.what_they_want: A service rather than medical devices or equipment: an integrated Public Health Nursing Service (0-25) covering Health Visiting, School Nursing and Family Nurse Partnership. Delivery is by a multidisciplinary workforce of qualified clinical and non-clinical staff, with Qualified Public Health Nurses providing professional leadership, clinical oversight and safeguarding expertise. The provider must use population health management and local intelligence, and work collaboratively with health, social care, education and other stakeholders. No device models or brands are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: NOT FOUND (the notice does not state formal certifications, experience or company size requirements). It only implies that the provider must have a qualified clinical workforce, including Qualified Public Health Nurses, and be able to work collaboratively with partners. Bidders must participate in the Provider Selection Regime Competitive Process.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND (no price or quality weightings are given in the notice). The only information is that the procurement follows the Competitive Process under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023.

tenders.original_title: ASC23043 - Positive Behaviour Support Supported Living Services in Herefordshire & Worcestershire DPS
tenders.english_summary: Worcestershire County Council and the NHS Worcestershire and Herefordshire Integrated Care Board are jointly establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) Supported Living Services in Herefordshire and Worcestershire. The DPS is now open to new applications for the rest of its term, with evaluation in periodic rounds (Round 1 deadline was 13 June 2024, 4pm; Round 2 timescales to be advertised). Admitted suppliers will be invited to take part in Mini Competitions (scheme/cluster placements) or Referrals (individual placements).
tenders.what_they_want: Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) Supported Living Services in Herefordshire and Worcestershire, which is a care service rather than a medical device. No devices, equipment, brands or model numbers are mentioned. Suppliers are admitted to the DPS for future placements.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Suppliers must be suitably experienced, qualified and appropriately accredited for PBS Supported Living Services. They must meet the selection criteria and minimum standards in the SSQ Questionnaire (Stage 1) and pass Evaluation (Stage 2). There is no maximum number of suppliers, and suppliers can apply at any time during the DPS term. Specific certifications, experience levels and company size requirements are NOT FOUND in this notice (they are in the tender documents).
tenders.evaluation_criteria: This is a 3-stage process. Stage 1 is the SSQ Questionnaire (selection criteria and minimum standards). Stage 2 is Evaluation, and applications are assessed in periodic rounds set by the Commissioner and advertised on In-Tend. Stage 3 is Mini Competitions or Referrals among admitted suppliers, as set out in Appendix 2 - DPS Agreement. Price and quality weightings are NOT FOUND.

tenders.original_title: Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS)
tenders.buyer_name: North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust
tenders.english_summary: North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust has re-opened its Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) in North Staffordshire and Stoke-on-Trent. Organisations can apply to qualify and join the DPS, which went live in February 2023 and runs for 5 years. Qualified providers will later be invited to request-for-quotation (Stage 2) competitions as individual service requirements arise.
tenders.what_they_want: A full range of CAMHS services, delivered face to face, digitally or in a blended approach. Services must cover the 0-25 age range, though most activity is expected in the 0-18 range. They must use a multi-disciplinary team approach, a strengths-based and trauma-informed approach with an outcome focus, and agreed outcome measure tools. Services must be timely, high quality and accessible for children, young people and their families/carers. There are no specified lots, but applicants must state their areas of expertise and delivery modalities. No medical devices, model numbers or brands are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Suitably experienced organisations that can provide CAMHS services. Applicants must complete the qualification and registration process through the MLCSU Atamis eTendering System. Only eligible and capable providers will be appointed to the DPS. Specific certifications, experience levels and company size requirements are NOT FOUND in this notice (they are likely in the qualification documents).
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND. Applicants are assessed at the qualification stage, and their stated areas of expertise and delivery modalities will be used to shortlist bidders for future Stage 2 requirements. Price and quality weightings are not stated. NHS Standard Terms and Conditions will apply.

tenders.original_title: P0819A - Application to join the Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for the Domestic Homicide Reporting
tenders.english_summary: Birmingham City Council, acting for the West Midlands Community Safety Partnership, invites applications to join a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for a combined Independent Author/Chair role. The role is to carry out statutory Domestic Homicide Reviews across the 7 West Midlands local authorities. These reviews look at deaths of people aged 16+ caused by violence, abuse or neglect by a relative, intimate partner or household member, so that lessons can be learned and future domestic abuse and homicide prevented. This is a service requirement, not a medical device purchase.
tenders.what_they_want: Independent Author/Chair services (a combined role) to conduct statutory Domestic Homicide Reviews in the 7 local authority areas: Birmingham, Coventry, Dudley, Sandwell, Solihull, Walsall and Wolverhampton. Reviews must identify and state lessons to be learnt, required changes, actions and timescales, apply those lessons to policies and procedures, and help prevent future domestic abuse and homicide. No medical devices, models or brands are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: NOT FOUND. The notice says only that all potential suppliers must pass the Stage 1 Selection criteria to be appointed to the DPS. Those criteria are not detailed in the notice and are in the tender documents. Suppliers must register on the in-tend e-tendering portal (https://in-tendhost.co.uk/birminghamcc/) to express interest and access the documents.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND. The notice describes only the two-stage structure. Stage 1 (Selection) is pass/fail against the selection criteria for DPS appointment. In Stage 2 (Award), invitations to tender go to all suppliers on the DPS for the Independent Author/Chair contract. Price and quality weightings are not stated. The DPS stays open to new suppliers throughout its duration.

tenders.original_title: Provision of Best Interest Assessors / Section 12 Doctors - Pseudo Open Framework
tenders.english_summary: Hull City Council is establishing an open "pseudo" framework agreement under the Light Touch Regime for the provision of Best Interest Assessors and Section 12 Doctors. The framework is expected to run from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2028, with an option to extend by up to 24 months. The estimated value is £200,000 per annum, which is not a commitment to purchase. Once the framework is in place, work will be awarded directly by rotation among the suppliers in each lot.
tenders.what_they_want: Professional services, not physical medical devices or equipment. Lot 1 is Best Interest Assessors (BIAs). Lot 2 is Section 12 Doctors (medical practitioners approved under Section 12 of the Mental Health Act). No model numbers or brands are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: NOT FOUND in the notice itself. The notice only says that all tender submission documents must be completed as detailed and that incomplete bids will be eliminated. Specific certifications, experience and company size requirements are in the framework documentation, which is not included here.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND. The notice gives no price/quality weightings. It says further information is in the framework documentation. After the framework is established, call-offs will be by direct award via rotation of the listed suppliers in each lot.

tenders.original_title: ASC23034 Dynamic Purchasing System for the Provision of Older People Residential and Nursing Care Long Term and Replacement Care Services
tenders.english_summary: Worcestershire County Council is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Older People Residential and Nursing Care services, covering long term and replacement care. The DPS will run for four years, with options to extend by two years and then a further two years (up to eight years in total). The estimated lifetime value is about £1,107,679,301 excluding VAT.
tenders.what_they_want: Residential and nursing care services for older people, split into three Lots that suppliers can apply for in any combination: Lot 1 - Long Term Care; Lot 2 - Short Term Replacement Care; Lot 3 - Emergency Short Term Replacement Care. This is a care service, not medical devices or equipment, and no models or brands are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Suppliers must be suitably experienced, qualified and appropriately accredited. Applicants complete a Standard Selection Questionnaire and upload the relevant documents through the portal. They must first click "Express Interest", then "Opt in", and finally "Submit your Return". Specific certifications, experience levels and company size requirements are NOT FOUND in the notice and are probably in the tender document set.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND (the notice says only that further details of the service and tender process are in the tender documents; no price or quality weightings are given)

tenders.english_summary: Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council is setting up a Mental Health Recovery Flexible Purchasing System (FPS) to buy community mental health care and support services in Rotherham. The new model is co-produced and recovery-focused. It aims to give people with mental ill-health more choice and control and to help them build and sustain independent living. The FPS is expected to run for about 5 years (indicative, and it may be extended with cabinet approval). Indicative spend is about £4m per annum within an existing budget of £5.7m (2022-2023), and there is no new funding.
tenders.what_they_want: Community mental health recovery services, not medical devices or equipment. The FPS will be divided into separate Lots, each specifying a community service with mental health recovery at its core. Examples given are supported living accommodation-based services and day opportunities. The services should provide personalised social care and help people achieve independent living skills and sustain independent living in their communities. No brands or model numbers are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Experienced providers with the capability and capacity to deliver community mental health care and support in Rotherham. Applicants must register with the Social Value Portal and commit to delivering Social Value additionality on all contracts awarded through the system. Specific certifications, company size requirements and minimum experience levels are NOT FOUND in this notice. They may be in the application documentation, which is available free of charge on YORtender under project ID 60316.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND. The notice gives no price/quality weightings or scoring methodology. It says full details of the application process are in the application documentation on YORtender (project ID 60316). Social Value commitment is a requirement.

tenders.english_summary: The UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) is setting up a 4-year Dynamic Purchasing System (2024-2028) to buy COVID-19 vaccine products for future immunisation campaigns. The potential aggregate value of all purchases under the DPS is £1 billion excluding VAT, and it may be awarded to one or more providers. No minimum volume or value is guaranteed, and the DPS only gives suppliers a route to take part in future competitive tenders (ITTs).
tenders.what_they_want: Supply of product(s) indicated for protection from COVID-19 (COVID-19 vaccines) for future UK immunisation programmes from 2024 to 2028. Annual volumes will be set by DHSC and UKHSA policy following JCVI advice on which cohorts to include. No specific brands or model numbers are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Suitably qualified suppliers must apply and be accepted onto the DPS through the Atamis eTendering system. Only suppliers already accepted onto the DPS when an ITT is issued can submit a tender, so early application is encouraged. The detailed qualifying criteria (certifications, experience, company size) are not given in this notice and are available on Atamis. Suppliers without an account can register for free. All correspondence must go through Atamis.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND (the notice gives no price or quality weightings. DPS applications are assessed against qualifying criteria on Atamis, and evaluation criteria for each call-off will be set in the individual ITTs.)

tenders.english_summary: Crown Commercial Service (CCS) intends to set up a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Facilities Management and Workplace Services. It is an alternative route to market for lower value and/or less complex contracts and is intended to attract SME suppliers. It complements the existing Facilities Management Marketplace framework (RM6232). It can be used by Central Government and all other UK public sector bodies, including local authorities, health, police, fire and rescue, education, housing, charities, nuclear and devolved administrations. Note that this is not a medical device tender.
tenders.what_they_want: Facilities management and workplace-related works and services for public sector estates. These include maintenance, response repairs, and supply and installation works. They also include CAFM (computer-aided facilities management), help-desk services and waste services. No medical devices, models or brands are mentioned. Suppliers will be organised into four categories: Services, Building Type, Location and Annual Contract Value. Customers can filter these to shortlist suppliers to invite to a competition.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: NOT FOUND. The notice only says the DPS aims to attract SME suppliers. Suppliers select the categories (services, building types, locations and contract values) that fit their offering. No certifications, experience or company size requirements are stated.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND. The notice gives no price/quality weightings. It says only that customers can filter suppliers by category to shortlist those invited to a competition.

tenders.english_summary: HUS (the Hospital District of Helsinki and Uusimaa) invites applications to join a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for ancillary supplies used in interventional radiology, neuroradiology and imaging. Suppliers may apply at any time while the DPS is valid. The actual purchases are made through mini-competitions run within the DPS, in which the specific requirements are described.
tenders.what_they_want: Various supplies and products used in interventional (procedural) radiology, neuroradiology and imaging. Where needed, related additional services such as training and consignment stock services are also covered. No specific model numbers or brands are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: Candidates must meet the suitability requirements stated in the ESPD (European Single Procurement Document) form. All candidates that meet these requirements are admitted to the DPS. Further details are in the request to participate and its appendices. No specific certifications, experience or company size requirements are stated in this notice text.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: Admission to the DPS is based only on meeting the suitability requirements, with no scoring or ranking of applicants. Evaluation criteria and weightings for price and quality are NOT FOUND in this notice. They will be set in the individual mini-competitions within the DPS.

tenders.english_summary: HUS-yhtymä (Finland) is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS), "Small rehabilitation aids and supplies and rehabilitation equipment 2026-2031", for small aids, supplies and equipment used in rehabilitation, nursing and daily living in primary and specialist healthcare. The DPS is valid until 25 June 2031. Individual purchases will be made through internal mini-competitions, each leading to a separate contract. The estimated maximum value is EUR 4,960,000 (excl. VAT) over a notional 5-year period, with no purchase volume commitment.
tenders.what_they_want: Small aids, supplies and equipment for nursing, rehabilitation and daily living. Product groups mentioned (examples only, not binding): kitchen and grasping aids; toilet and hygiene aids plus protective equipment; transfer ergonomics and positioning aids; therapy supplies and tools; small rehabilitation supplies and exercise equipment; rehabilitation devices and device-related supplies (details in Annex 1, "Product groups and questions of the request for information"). Other small aids, supplies and devices may also be included. HUS expects at least two internal competitions in 2026-2031: (1) small rehabilitation aids and supplies, and (2) rehabilitation devices and device-related supplies, possibly plus other individual competitions. The DPS excludes small aids and devices procured through Aid Centres (Apuvälinekeskus) on payment commitments. Besides HUS, the purchasers may include HUS's owner members (City of Helsinki, Itä-Uusimaa, Keski-Uusimaa, Vantaa-Kerava and Länsi-Uusimaa wellbeing services counties), the YTA-area wellbeing services counties (Kymenlaakso, Etelä-Karjala, Päijät-Häme) and the Finnish Defence Forces. No brands or model numbers are mentioned.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: NOT FOUND (the notice text is truncated and gives no specific certification, experience or company size requirements; it only states that suppliers submit participation requests, which can be submitted throughout the DPS's duration)
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND (the notice does not give evaluation criteria or weightings; the products and award criteria will be specified in each internal competition)

tenders.english_summary: Fakultní nemocnice Bulovka (Bulovka University Hospital, Czechia) is establishing a dynamic purchasing system (DNS) for supplying medical consumables to its departments and clinics. Individual contracts will later be awarded within the DNS through calls for tenders under Section 141 of the Czech Public Procurement Act (ZZVZ). These contracts may also include equipment loans or standalone equipment purchases.
tenders.what_they_want: Consumable medical materials for the hospital's departments and clinics. Depending on the individual contract, this may include loan of equipment needed to use the consumables, and separate supply of equipment falling under the classification of the DNS. No specific models or brands are mentioned. Detailed specifications will be set in each call for tenders.
tenders.eligibility_requirements: NOT FOUND. Conditions will be defined in each call for tenders within the DNS.
tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND. Criteria will be set in each call for tenders within the DNS.

tenders.evaluation_criteria: NOT FOUND (the notice refers to the tender documents)

tenders.original_title: Italy – Miscellaneous medical devices and products

tenders.english_summary: The Azienda Sanitaria Universitaria Integrata del Trentino (Italy) has issued a call for expressions of interest for the supply of consumables for its ECMO (extracorporeal membrane oxygenation) equipment, specifically the CARDIOHELP console model it already owns. tenders.english_summary: Region Värmland in Sweden is procuring 6 coagulation instruments together with equipment-specific consumables and service. The tender covers the analyzers, the reagents and consumables tied to them, and ongoing servicing.
tenders.what_they_want: 6 coagulation instruments (analyzers for blood coagulation testing), equipment-bound consumables (reagents and other supplies tied to the instruments), and service/maintenance. No brands or model numbers are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Czechia – Devices and instruments for infusion
tenders.english_summary: Fakultní nemocnice Motol a Homolka (a Czech university hospital) is tendering for the ongoing supply of implantable ports and accessories for its own needs. The contract will be a framework agreement concluded with a single supplier under the binding tender conditions.
tenders.what_they_want: Continuous deliveries of implantable ports and related accessories (referred to as "SZM", i.e. specific medical material). No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.buyer_name: Wiener Gesundheitsverbund - Abteilung Vergabe- und Vertragsmanagement
tenders.english_summary: The Wiener Gesundheitsverbund (Vienna Health Association), through its Procurement and Contract Management department, intends to conclude a framework agreement for the supply of medical technology equipment. The equipment is divided into several device groups (lots).
tenders.what_they_want: Medical technology devices and equipment in several device groups. The notice does not name specific devices, models or brands.

tenders.buyer_name: Ústřední vojenská nemocnice - Vojenská fakultní nemocnice Praha
tenders.english_summary: The Central Military Hospital – Military University Hospital Prague (Czechia) is tendering for the supply of 2 surgical drills (vrtačky). The contract also includes free warranty and post-warranty servicing for 6 years, plus ongoing supplies of consumable medical material.
tenders.what_they_want: 2 units of drills (vrtačky, likely surgical or orthopaedic drill systems; the notice does not specify the type). It also covers 6 years of free warranty and post-warranty service for the offered device, and continuous supply of consumable medical material for the drills. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Germany – Petroleum products, fuel, electricity and other sources of energy
tenders.english_summary: Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (a German research association) is seeking a supplier to provide rented bulk tank installations and regular deliveries of liquid nitrogen and liquid argon for several of its institutes (FMP, PDI, MBI, IKZ). The tender also covers rented cylinders and bundles of various technical gases for the FMP and other uses. This is a gas and energy supply contract, not a medical device purchase.
tenders.what_they_want: Liquid nitrogen and argon supplied on a yearly basis, plus rented cryogenic tanks. All tank rental prices include delivery, installation, removal of the old tank, installation of the new tank, commissioning, maintenance and repair. Delivery surcharges (GGVZ and toll, energy and others) are charged on top. The total gas quantity may be exceeded by up to 25%.

tenders.english_summary: Fakultní nemocnice Motol a Homolka (a Czech hospital) is tendering for the ongoing supply of catheter-implantable pulmonary valves for the hospital's needs. The contract will be awarded as a framework agreement with a single supplier, under the binding tender conditions.
tenders.what_they_want: Continuous deliveries of catheter-implantable pulmonary heart valves (referred to as "SZM", i.e. specific medical material) for the hospital. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: The Vienna Health Association (Wiener Gesundheitsverbund) is running an open procedure to buy washer-disinfectors for the AKH Vienna hospital. The tender has two categories, each for 2 units, that differ in capacity. Each category covers delivery, installation, user training, technician training and commissioning.
tenders.what_they_want: Category 1: 2 cleaning and disinfection devices (washer-disinfectors) with a capacity of at least 15 DIN trays (DIN-Siebe), including delivery, assembly/installation, user training, technician training and commissioning. Category 2: 2 cleaning and disinfection devices (washer-disinfectors) with a capacity of at least 30 DIN trays, including the same services. The notice names no brands or model numbers. The equipment is for AKH Wien (Vienna General Hospital).

tenders.english_summary: Fakultní nemocnice Brno (Brno University Hospital) is seeking a supplier of vital signs monitors with a central station for its Clinic of Pediatric Surgery, Orthopedics and Traumatology, located at the Children's Hospital site (Černopolní 9, Brno). The tender also covers the supply of consumables under an 8-year framework purchase agreement and post-warranty servicing under an indefinite-term service contract.
tenders.what_they_want: (1) Vital signs monitors with a central station for the Clinic of Pediatric Surgery, Orthopedics and Traumatology (KDCHOT). (2) Supply of consumables under a framework purchase agreement concluded for 8 years. (3) Post-warranty service for the supplied goods under a service contract concluded for an indefinite period. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Germany – Petroleum products, fuel, electricity and other sources of energy
tenders.english_summary: Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (a research association in Germany) is seeking a supplier for rented cryogenic tank installations and deliveries of liquid nitrogen and liquid argon for several of its institutes (FMP, PDI, MBI, IKZ). It also covers rented cylinder, bundle and dewar supply of various technical gases. The notice is for gas supply and tank rental, not medical devices, and the description is cut off at the end.
tenders.what_they_want: Liquid nitrogen for FMP: 284,458 kg/year, with rental of four tanks (7,000 L without evaporator, 7,000 L with evaporator, 10,526 L without evaporator, 18,622 L with evaporator). Liquid nitrogen for PDI: 425,000 L/year, with a 17,000 L tank without evaporator and a 2,000 L tank with evaporator. Liquid nitrogen for MBI: 348,575 L/year, with an 8,973 L tank and a 2,850 L tank, both without evaporator. Liquid argon for IKZ: 25,101.86 L/year, with a 3,310 L tank with evaporator. Rental tank prices must cover delivery, installation, removal of the old tank, installation of the new tank, commissioning, maintenance and repair. Gas prices are quoted plus GGVZ (dangerous goods) and toll surcharges, energy surcharges and other surcharges. Cylinder and bundle gases for FMP, rented: argon 6 x 50 L cylinders/year; carbogen 8 x 50 L; hydrogen 1 x 10 L; nitrogen 2 x 10 L; CO2 5 x 10 L cylinders and 9 x 12x50 L bundles/year. Further cylinder and dewar supply (rented) of argon, acetylene, nitrous oxide, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, sulphur dioxide, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, air and methane, plus nitrogen to fill two (text truncated). For each lot, total gas volume may be exceeded by at most 25%. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.buyer_name: Atvasināta publiska persona "Latvijas Valsts koksnes ķīmijas institūts"
tenders.english_summary: The Latvian State Institute of Wood Chemistry, a derived public entity, is procuring laboratory materials and reagents for the performance of contract No. 32-25. The notice is classified as "Chemical products". It is not a medical device tender, and the description is a single phrase repeated many times with no further detail.
tenders.what_they_want: Laboratory materials and reagents (chemical products) for contract No. 32-25. No specific products, quantities, brands or model numbers are given.

tenders.buyer_name: Inspección General de Sanidad de la Defensa
tenders.english_summary: The Inspección General de Sanidad de la Defensa (Spanish Defence Health Inspectorate) is tendering for the acquisition of various patient monitoring equipment. The equipment is intended for the HCD, most likely the Hospital Central de la Defensa. The notice gives only a brief description and no further commercial details.
tenders.what_they_want: Various monitoring equipment ("diferentes equipos de monitorización") for the HCD. No specific device types, quantities, brands or model numbers are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Germany – Sterilisation, disinfection and hygiene devices
tenders.english_summary: Heidekreis-Klinikum gGmbH is procuring a complete endoscope reprocessing system for its new hospital building in Bad Fallingbostel, Germany. The lot covers delivery, installation, commissioning and maintenance of washer-disinfectors, drying systems and accessories. It must be supplied and operated as a single, functionally integrated solution.
tenders.what_they_want: Delivery, installation, commissioning and maintenance of endoscope reprocessing equipment, comprising: (1) washer-disinfectors for flexible endoscopes (RDG-E); (2) drying systems; (3) required accessories, including connectors, endoscope baskets, and transport and storage systems; (4) instruction and training services; (5) maintenance, servicing and revalidation of the systems. The systems must meet requirements for hygiene, process reliability and documentation, and must integrate with the existing IT infrastructure. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Sweden – Medical equipments, pharmaceuticals and personal care products
tenders.english_summary: Region Stockholm's Property and Service Committee/Service Administration is procuring surgical-grade instruments for open surgery. The tender is divided into 20 tender areas (lots) and includes an option for marking (labelling) the instruments.
tenders.what_they_want: Surgical instruments of operating-room quality for open surgery, divided into 20 tender areas, plus an optional service for marking/labelling the instruments. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Sweden – Medical equipments, pharmaceuticals and personal care products
tenders.english_summary: Region Stockholm's central purchasing function (Fastighets- och servicenämnden/Inköpscentralen) is running a tender for bloodless field (tourniquet) equipment and the related consumables. The notice gives only a one-line description, with no further detail on scope, quantities or terms.
tenders.what_they_want: Blood-emptying/bloodless field equipment (the original text says "blodtomhetsutrustning", which typically means surgical tourniquet systems used to create a bloodless surgical field) and associated consumables. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: The Hellenic Pasteur Institute (Greece) is tendering for the supply of laboratory consumables and reagents. These include filter pipette tips, PCR tubes and plates, molecular diagnostic PCR kits for many pathogens, serology kits, enzymes and mixes, nucleic acid and protein isolation kits, and digital PCR supplies. The notice text is truncated at the end, so the full list may be incomplete.
tenders.what_they_want: Consumables: filter tips (0.1-10, 0-20, 0-200 and 100-1000 µl); 8-well PCR strips (white and clear) and clear caps; 0.2 ml PCR tubes; 1.5 ml and 2.0 ml microcentrifuge tubes; 2 ml collection tubes without caps; 81-position cardboard cryo boxes; 96-well clear PCR plates; sterile Petri dishes (90/15.8 mm, no compartments); 10 µl plastic inoculation loops; nitrogen cylinders. Real-time PCR molecular diagnostic kits for: Toxoplasma gondii; hepatitis A (qualitative RNA); hepatitis B (quantitative); hepatitis D (quantitative); hepatitis E (qualitative); respiratory virus syndromic panel; Cryptosporidium/Giardia/E. histolytica; Blastocystis hominis/Dientamoeba fragilis; West Nile virus RNA (quantitative); adenovirus (quantitative); Epstein-Barr virus (quantitative); cytomegalovirus (quantitative); Bordetella pertussis/parapertussis; Chlamydia pneumoniae; Chlamydia trachomatis; Ureaplasma urealyticum/parvum. Genetic tests: Apolipoprotein E gene genotyping; TPMT polymorphism kit. Serology kits: West Nile virus IgG and IgM; Dengue IgG, IgM and NS1 antigen. Enzymes and reagents: AluI restriction enzyme; 2X one-step RT-PCR enzyme mix with labelled probes (ROX-free); DNA PCR enzyme mixes (probe-based and single reaction); Hot-Start polymerase mix; recombinant RNase inhibitor; DNA polymerase mix for conventional PCR; one-step RNA enzyme mix for real-time PCR; recombinant reverse transcriptase; complete high-sensitivity One-Step RT-PCR kit. Isolation and purification kits: PCR product purification column kits (x2); DNA isolation from tissue/blood (columns); RNA isolation from biological samples and from tissues (columns); MagCore genomic nucleic acid isolation kits (whole blood and tissue); total DNA isolation from paraffin-embedded tissue. Other: protein separation kit (12-230 kDa); chemiluminescence detection kit without secondary antib

tenders.english_summary: The University Clinical Hospital in Poznań, Poland, is procuring breast-related medical devices. These are tissue expanders, anatomical breast implants and markers, typically used in breast reconstruction and plastic surgery. The notice gives only a brief product list.
tenders.what_they_want: Tissue expanders (ekspandery), anatomical breast implants (implanty piersi anatomiczne), breast implants (implanty piersi) and markers (znaczniki). No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: The Municipality of Hengelo (Netherlands) is seeking two contract partners to supply, maintain and manage Wmo (Social Support Act) assistive devices under a rental arrangement, as the current agreement for providing, renting and occasionally selling aids expires on 31 December 2026. The contractor must cover service, maintenance, management and re-issuing (redistribution) of the devices.
tenders.what_they_want: Wmo medical/assistive aids supplied on a rental basis, including delivery, service, maintenance, management and re-issuance of the devices. Shower and toilet facilities with a catalogue price of €500 excl. VAT or less are to be purchased and provided as owned items. More expensive items may be provided on loan by the contracting authority. No specific models or brands are mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: Úrazová nemocnice v Brně (Trauma Hospital in Brno, Czechia) is procuring a new magnetic resonance (MR/MRI) scanner, including delivery, installation, commissioning, testing, calibration and operator training. The contract also covers 6 years of post-warranty servicing of the device.
tenders.what_they_want: One new, non-refurbished MRI scanner in the latest version, with no prior upgrades. It must support diagnostics of the head, brain, neck, all spinal levels, thoracic organs, abdominal organs including MRCP, pelvic organs, and joints including small joints, in both children and adults. Required examinations are angiography with and without contrast, perfusion imaging, and high-resolution diffusion imaging with ADC maps. The scanner must support the latest sequences with synchronisation to physiological functions, the latest scan acceleration function without loss of quality, faster sequence planning, and full equipment with state-of-the-art evaluation software. It must also support paediatric examinations, including gradient noise reduction. The scope includes delivery, installation, commissioning, testing for proper operation, calibration, connection of all components, and operator training in line with Act No. 375/2022 Coll. on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices. It also includes 6 years of post-warranty servicing. The detailed specification is in Annex 1 (Technical Specification), which is not included in the notice. No brand or model is mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: Fakultní nemocnice Hradec Králové (University Hospital Hradec Králové, Czechia) is tendering for the supply of one new radiofrequency generator with ablation catheters for its 2nd Internal Gastroenterology Clinic. The contract also covers accessories, related technologies, warranty and post-warranty services, and the supply of unique consumables and materials needed to operate the system.
tenders.what_they_want: 1 new radiofrequency (RF) generator with ablation catheters, including accessories and related technologies. Warranty and post-warranty service and maintenance. Unique consumables and materials necessary for operation, if the offered technical solution requires them. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: Region Jämtland Härjedalen (Sweden) intends to procure one 3T magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scanner, including a complete RF cage. It will replace one of Östersund Hospital's existing MRI scanners, which has reached the end of its technical life. The unit will be installed ready for operation in the hospital's radiology department.
tenders.what_they_want: One (1) fixed-installation, operational 3T MRI scanner including a complete RF cage (RF shielding), for the radiology department at Östersund Hospital. It must be delivered with a detachable patient table and a contrast injector, as set out in the requirement specification. Optional extras requested: an MR-compatible wheelchair, left/right side markers, a technical solution for film viewing in the examination room, and a ferromagnetic detector at the door. No brands or model numbers are mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: ASST di Bergamo Ovest, an Italian public healthcare provider, is tendering for the supply of an EBUS system, meaning a video-bronchoscopy and bronchial endoscopy system. The notice gives only a one-line description, so no further commercial detail is available.
tenders.what_they_want: Supply of an EBUS (endobronchial ultrasound) system for video-bronchoscopy and bronchial endoscopy. No model numbers, brands, quantities or technical specifications are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Italy – Miscellaneous medical devices and products
tenders.english_summary: The Azienda Ospedaliero-Universitaria "Renato Dulbecco" (Italy) is tendering for the supply of miscellaneous medical devices and consumables, divided into 15 lots. The lots cover disposable ECG and monitoring electrodes, neurophysiology electrodes (cup and needle types), and related accessories such as caps, adhesive paste, adapter cables and blunt needles.
tenders.what_they_want: 15 lots: (1) Disposable electrodes for long-term monitoring (intensive care, Holter); (2) Disposable electrodes for routine resting ECG; (3) Disposable electrodes for stress tests or short-term monitoring; (4) Disposable electrodes for paediatric ECG; (5) Repositionable single-patient adhesives; (6) Cup electrodes with central hole; (7) Cup electrodes without hole; (8) Concentric needle electrodes; (9) Monopolar needle electrodes; (10) Caps (headsets/caps); (11) Tubes of adhesive paste; (12) Adapter cable; (13) Emergency electrode; (14) Blunt needle; (15) Single-patient caps. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: Krajská zdravotní, a.s. is seeking a ten-year loan (lease-type provision) of haematology blood count analysers and coagulation analysers for the haematology laboratories of its branch establishments. The contract also covers recurring supplies of tied consumables, backup power (UPS), full service support, middleware and building-readiness works.
tenders.what_they_want: (1) Loan of haematology blood count analysers and coagulation analysers for 10 years. (2) Recurring deliveries of tied consumables needed for haematology and coagulation tests. (3) Supply and installation of UPS backup power sources, with enough capacity to run all analysers during a power outage, at least long enough to finish analyses in progress. (4) Full service support. (5) Supply of middleware linking all analysers, per the technical specification. (6) Building-readiness works in line with the tender documentation. No brands or model numbers are mentioned. The buyer allows a site visit under §36 and §97 of the Czech Public Procurement Act (ZZVZ).

tenders.original_title: Poland – Medical equipments, pharmaceuticals and personal care products
tenders.buyer_name: Narodowy Instytut Kardiologii Stefana Kardynała Wyszyńskiego - Państwowy Instytut Badawczy
tenders.english_summary: The National Institute of Cardiology (Narodowy Instytut Kardiologii Stefana Kardynała Wyszyńskiego) in Poland has issued a tender for medical equipment, pharmaceuticals and personal care products. tenders.what_they_want: NOT FOUND. The notice gives only the general category "medical equipments, pharmaceuticals and personal care products". The specific items, models and brands are in Annex 2 to the SWZ, which is not included.

tenders.what_they_want: Vital signs monitors (patient monitors, referred to in the notice as "přístroj" / "device") including accessories. No model numbers, brands or quantities are mentioned.

tenders.what_they_want: Various medical consumables (sanitetski materijal), a one-year supply of medical consumables for paediatric palliative care needs, and a one-year supply of thermal paper. No specific model numbers, brands or quantities are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Finland – Furniture (incl. office furniture), furnishings, domestic appliances (excl. lighting) and cleaning products
tenders.english_summary: Helsingin Seniorisäätiö sr (a Helsinki senior housing foundation) is procuring furniture and care equipment in three lots: care furniture, office furniture, and medical/care items such as medication trolleys, mattresses, beds and shower chairs. Item details, quantities and requirements are in Annex 2 (Price and Requirements Annex), which is not included in this notice.
tenders.what_they_want: Lot 1: care furniture (hoivakalusteet). Lot 2: office furniture (toimistokalusteet). Lot 3: a medication cart/trolley, medium-risk and high-risk pressure-relief mattresses, senior beds and shower chairs. Specific items, quantities and technical requirements are in Annex 2, which is not provided. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.english_summary: The Specialist Hospital named after the Holy Family (Szpital Specjalistyczny im. Świętej Rodziny SPZOZ) in Poland is procuring medical equipment and apparatus for its Operating Theatre Block. The notice is titled "Electrosurgical unit". It is divided into 10 parts (Annexes 2.1 to 2.10), each covering supply, delivery, installation and commissioning of equipment as set out in technical and functional parameter forms.
tenders.what_they_want: Sale, delivery, installation and commissioning at the buyer's premises of medical equipment and apparatus for the hospital's Operating Theatre Block, specified in 10 technical-and-functional parameter forms (Annexes 2.1 to 2.10). The title indicates an electrosurgical unit, but the description does not name the specific equipment in each annex. No brands or model numbers are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Germany – Medical equipments, pharmaceuticals and personal care products
tenders.english_summary: Gesundheitsmanagementgesellschaft mbH is running a central procurement of consumable medical supplies for emergency-service practices (Notdienstpraxen) in the Nordrhein region of Germany. The notice covers "Sprechstundenbedarf" (SSB, consulting-hour supplies used in the course of treatment) and "Praxisbedarf" (PB, general practice supplies). The tender is categorised under medical equipment, pharmaceuticals and personal care products.
tenders.what_they_want: Central supply of SSB (consulting-hour consumables) and PB (practice supplies) for out-of-hours emergency practices in the Nordrhein area. No specific models, brands, quantities or product lists are given in the notice text provided.

tenders.english_summary: Fakultní nemocnice Motol (a Czech university hospital) is seeking the supply, installation and commissioning of a new endoscopic system, including accessories. The contract also covers servicing of the equipment for its expected lifetime, which is at least 10 years.
tenders.what_they_want: A new endoscopic system with accessories, delivered, installed and put into operation. Service support for the equipment for at least 10 years. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.original_title: Germany – Medical equipments, pharmaceuticals and personal care products
tenders.english_summary: Klinikum Bad Salzungen GmbH (Germany) is procuring patient monitoring equipment. This covers hemodynamic patient monitors for endoscopy, recovery room and MRI preparation areas, a central patient monitoring station, and an MRI-compatible (non-magnetic) patient monitor. Delivery, installation, configuration, training and commissioning are included.

All items include delivery, ready-to-operate installation, configuration, user training and commissioning.

tenders.english_summary: Moravskoslezská nemocnice Opava (a Czech public hospital) is seeking a supplier for ongoing, repeated deliveries of surgical medical consumables over a two-year period. Goods will be delivered to a buyer-established consignment warehouse located in the central operating theatres (3rd floor, room no. 207). Delivery is based on actual needs and individual orders, in line with the minimum technical conditions and price offer in Annex 4 of the tender documentation.
tenders.what_they_want: Medical consumables (disposable supplies) for surgery, supplied on a recurring basis to a consignment stock at the central operating theatres. The price includes transport to the place of delivery. Specific products, models and brands are not named in the notice; they are set out in Annex No. 4 of the tender documentation (Minimum technical conditions and price offer).

tenders.english_summary: Nemocnice Pardubického kraje, a.s. (Czechia) is tendering for ongoing, repeated supplies of special medical consumables, reagents and antibodies used for immunohistochemical detection of antigens. The goods fall under Czech Act No. 375/2022 Coll. on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices. The contract also includes a free loan of a backup immunohistochemistry automated staining analyser.
tenders.what_they_want: Continuous, repeated deliveries of special medical material, reagents and antibodies (in vitro diagnostic devices) for immunohistochemical examination of antigens, plus a free-of-charge loan of a backup automated immunohistochemistry instrument/stainer. Detailed specifications are in the tender documentation and its annexes. No model numbers or brands are mentioned in this notice.

tenders.buyer_name: Wojewódzki Szpital Specjalistyczny w Białej Podlaskiej
tenders.english_summary: Wojewódzki Szpital Specjalistyczny in Biała Podlaska (Poland) is procuring consumables and accessories for cardiac ablation procedures to treat atrial fibrillation and ventricular tachycardia. All items must be compatible with the hospital's existing Ensite X 3D mapping system and its RF and PFA (pulsed field ablation) generator, as well as the St. Jude Medical AMPER generator. The detailed specifications are set out in Annex No. 2 to the tender documentation (SWZ), which was not included in the notice text.
tenders.what_they_want: (1) A set for ablation procedures for atrial fibrillation and ventricular tachycardia, compatible with the existing 3D Ensite X system and the RF and PFA generator. (2) Ablation catheters and connection cables for the St. Jude Medical AMPER generator. (3) Accessories for atrial fibrillation and ventricular tachycardia ablation procedures, compatible with the existing 3D Ensite X system. (4) Dispersive (indifferent/return) electrodes for the existing St. Jude Medical AMPER generator. Quantities and detailed specifications are in Annex 2 to the SWZ. NOT FOUND for specific model numbers beyond the Ensite X and AMPER (St. Jude Medical) system names.

tenders.english_summary: Fakultní nemocnice Brno (Brno University Hospital, Czechia) is running a tender to conclude a framework purchase agreement for the supply of medical materials according to the buyer's needs. The notice title classifies it under endoscopy and endosurgery devices, but the description itself gives no further detail.
tenders.what_they_want: Medical supplies/materials ("zdravotnický materiál") supplied under a framework purchase agreement as needed by the contracting authority. The title suggests endoscopy and endosurgery devices. No specific products, models, brands or quantities are mentioned.

tenders.buyer_name: Mazowieckie Centrum Leczenia Chorób Płuc i Gruźlicy
tenders.english_summary: The Mazowieckie Centrum Leczenia Chorób Płuc i Gruźlicy (Mazovian Centre for Treatment of Lung Diseases and Tuberculosis) in Poland is seeking laboratory reagents together with leased analyser equipment, divided into 7 packages. The reagents cover TB drug-susceptibility testing, detection of co-infecting viral and bacterial pathogens, and several immunoassay methods. Although the notice title says "Medical furniture", the content concerns in-vitro diagnostic reagents and equipment leasing.
tenders.what_they_want: Seven packages, each combining reagents with leased equipment. Package 1: reagents for detecting susceptibility to anti-tuberculosis drugs and for confirming viral and bacterial diseases co-occurring with TB, including resistance mechanisms, in patient samples by RT-PCR, plus lease of a Real-time PCR analyser. Package 2: reagents for detecting antigens of fastidious (slow-growing) bacteria and viruses in patient samples using high-sensitivity methods, plus lease of an analyser. Package 3: reagents plus lease of an analyser for chemiluminescence testing. Package 4: reagents plus lease of an analyser for electrochemiluminescence testing. Package 5: reagents plus lease of an analyser for immunoenzymatic (ELISA-type) testing. Package 6: reagents plus lease of an analyser for immunoblot testing. Package 7: reagents, tests and auxiliary materials plus lease of an analyser for multiplex PCR testing. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.

tenders.buyer_name: Samodzielny Publiczny Zakład Opieki Zdrowotnej w Świdniku
tenders.english_summary: The Independent Public Healthcare Facility (SPZOZ) in Świdnik, Poland, is seeking the supply of medical equipment for its specialist outpatient clinics. The tender is split into five parts: general equipment for specialist clinics, equipment for the Urology clinic, an ultrasound (USG) device, an X-ray (RTG) device with installation, and a medical queuing system with computer sets. Detailed specifications, price forms and the draft contract are in annexes to the tender specification (SWZ).
tenders.what_they_want: 1) Medical equipment for the SPZOZ Specialist Clinics (Annex 1.1 to SWZ, price form 2.1). 2) Medical equipment for the Urology Clinic (Annex 1.2, price form 2.2). 3) Supply of an ultrasound (USG) apparatus (Annex 1.3, price form 2.3). 4) Supply and installation of an X-ray (RTG) apparatus (Annex 1.4, price form 2.4). 5) Supply of a medical queuing system with computer sets (Annex 1.5, price form 2.5). Delivery terms are set in the draft contract (Annex 8 to SWZ). No specific brands or model numbers are mentioned in the notice itself.

tenders.buyer_name: Wojewódzki Szpital Specjalistyczny im. Św. Jadwigi w Opolu
tenders.english_summary: The Saint Jadwiga Specialist Provincial Hospital in Opole, Poland, is procuring the purchase and delivery of single-use (disposable) medical equipment for its Neuroradiological Early Intervention Centre at ul. Wodociągowa 4, 45-221 Opole. The procurement is divided into lots (tasks). Most of the repeated descriptions state 18 lots, and one states 4 lots.

The tender appears to be split into multiple lots, and providers can bid for one or several.
tenders.what_they_want: Occupational health services: work-focused medical assessments, fitness-for-work advice, adjustments, health surveillance and case-specific clinical guidance for management. This is limited to medical and capability advice, or mandated work-related interventions such as drug and alcohol counselling. General counselling is included only if the provider wins multiple lots. EAP: 24/7 confidential counselling and advice for employees and immediate family members (typically dependants aged 16+). It includes short-term counselling by phone, online or in person, practical legal, financial and family advice, and structured clinical triage to identify cases needing other interventions such as specialist therapy or OH referral. Communications and engagement support: working with SDS internal Communications on campaigns, uptake analysis and staff content. Extended therapeutic interventions: e.g. Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), trauma-focused counselling and other structured interventions beyond short-term EAP counselling. These are called off after an EAP or management recommendation and are not bundled into the core EAP fee. Manager helpline: a non-clinical advice and coaching line for managers handling difficult people situations, such as staff mental health issues, sensitive conversations and crisis support. It must not give HR, legal or procedural advice or direct employment decisions. Neurodiversity services: specialist evaluations of potentially neurodivergent employees by qualified practitioners, separate from OH, with workplace-focused recommendations. Adjustment support: post-assessment support for individuals or teams to implement adjustments and build capability. Equipment: recommended adjustments such as chairs, desks and peripherals, supplied via pre-defined catalogues and pricing. Software: specialised software for disabled and neurodivergent employees, plus training in its use. No model numbers or brands are mentioned.
